readme: Commodity x store cells confirmed (by manual verification) that the store genuinely does not carry a comparable product. build-deals-page.ps1 renders these as a 'Does not carry' cell with a 'See it? Let us know!' link to /suggest-an-item/. Keyed list of {id, store}.
